notes: Official USA manual geometry provides Uniracers-specific evidence for 7:6 horizontal correction of the 256-wide source; see analysis/display-reference-geometry.json.

Authentic/reference geometry therefore preserves all 224 active source rows. CRT-style overscan/crop remains a separate optional display treatment rather than part of the canonical logical raster.
